decisions.reason: Turnaround management software has its own page, sits at the core of the announced data-driven airport operations direction, and carries substantial visible investment, so management persists with it.

The apron connectivity module is a building block of the integrated digital platform, and slow uptake can still be attributed to long airport procurement cycles, so withdrawal would contradict the announced strategy.
Apron resource management is close to the core offer and integral to the end-to-end operations suite, so sunk development costs and strategic fit favour keeping it.

The controller safety alert service supports the firm's tower and safety positioning, and slow adoption among air navigation providers is read as temporary, though it is the least central of the remaining products.
